# Jurisdiction pack: EU

as_of: 2026-07-01

## Data protection
GDPR (Regulation (EU) 2016/679). Article 17 covers erasure, Article 20 portability.
Source: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj

## AI regulation
EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689), phased application from 2026-08-02 for GPAI obligations.
Source: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1689/oj
